DARV.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-1.char: [i][font_size=22]Calyrex gives a slight nod. The reins chime. [/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-2.ancient: I've met crowns. I've met reins. Both at once? You're the first!!
DARV.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.1-0r.ancient: Still alive!! And the steeds still carry you!!
DARV.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-0.ancient: Someone is counting your hoofbeats in the dark!!
DARV.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-1.char: [i][font_size=22]Calyrex stays silent, but the reins go taut. [/font_size][/i]
DARV.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-2.ancient: Whoa, I said nothing!! Ask me again after the next floor!!
NONUPEIPE.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-0.anc: You carry the scent of mountains.
NONUPEIPE.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-2.anc: That is why they still stand.
NONUPEIPE.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.1-0r.an: You tread my stone path again.
NONUPEIPE.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-0.anc: Something in the mist is learning your footsteps.
NONUPEIPE.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-1.cha: [i][font_size=22]It cannot learn the sound of the reins. [/font_size][/i]
OROBAS.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-0.ancien: The shadow of the black steed arrived before you.
OROBAS.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-2.ancien: That depends on whether it will wait.
OROBAS.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.1-0r.ancie: The shadow has grown an inch longer.
OROBAS.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-0.ancien: Your other steed shivered in the ice.
OROBAS.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-2.ancien: It was never the ice that feared the cold.
PAEL.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-0.ancient: Crown and reins. You hesitated long before taking both.
PAEL.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-2.ancient: One set. No one dared think it.
PAEL.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-0.ancient: Someone wants to separate you from your steeds.
TANX.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-0.ancient: The snow beneath you holds no footprints.
TANX.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-1.char: [i][font_size=22]The snow is deep. They were covered. [/font_size][/i]
TANX.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-2.ancient: Or the steed carries you, so you never touch the ground?
TANX.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.1-0r.ancient: Still no footprints in the snow.
TANX.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-0.ancient: There is a pit ahead. Something in it is counting you.
TANX.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-1.char: [i][font_size=22]Let it count. At seven, it falls silent. [/font_size][/i]
TEZCATARA.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-0.anc: Ice and shadow. You hold both.
TEZCATARA.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-2.anc: Two forces that do not conflict point to the same end.
TEZCATARA.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.1-0r.an: The end has not come, yet you return first.
TEZCATARA.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-0.anc: Your steed whinnied in the night.
TEZCATARA.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-2.anc: Something that should not have woken answered back.
VAKUU.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-0.ancient: You brought two steeds through a narrow gate.
VAKUU.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-2.ancient: It was the steeds that obeyed.
VAKUU.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-0.ancient: The last gate lets only one rider and one steed pass.
VAKUU.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-1.char: [i][font_size=22]One will become ice, the other shadow. [/font_size][/i]
VAKUU.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-2.ancient: Until you walk through, and they rejoin.
NEOW.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.2-1.char: [i][font_size=22]Calyrex says nothing. Both steeds raise their hooves at once. [/font_size][/i]
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-0: I have watched worlds collapse and rebuilt them anew.
Then judge whether my path holds firm.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.1-0: Crowned one, your path is unfinished.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-1: Crowned one, your strength comes from bonds, not stone.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.CALYREX_CHARACTER.0-2: Go. My creations will test your resolve.
